messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high 429 rate detected in prod us-east-1 on /v1/generate (rate-limiter). KPIs: 429 spike to 28% of requests, token accounting errors increasing. Pager: @oncall Amelia Park.
Amelia Park: i'm on it — switching to the oncall channel, grabbing logs.
Mateo Lopez: looking at dashboards now, seeing a deploy around 16:42 UTC 2320000000 that touched rlv2 ratecap routing.
Priya Singh: i can check exemptions table, quick question: did the canary change include the exemptions rewrite?
Alex Wu: yes, the deploy included the new exemptions hot-path in dispatcher (commit abc123 -> def456). Canary was 5% but metrics show surge after 2m.
Lia Gomez: i'm seeing auth tokens for internal customers not matching exemption rules — they get counted and hit the ratecap.
Amelia Park: impact? which customers? are billing tokens affected?
Mateo Lopez: noticed elevated 429s for these customer slugs: acme-inc, finco-pay, studyhub. Support says multiple SEVs.
Priya Singh: digging into token-lookup logs — the exemptions cache ttl code path returns empty for hd_* tokens after that commit. looks like cache key change.
Alex Wu: ugh, cache key normalization change slipped through. the canary baked but exemptions sample was small. need immediate mitigation.
Amelia Park: options: 1) flip kill-switch for rlv2 rollout (feature flag) 2) rollback the deploy 3) patch exemptions service in prod. fastest is kill-switch/rollback. which is less risky?
Mateo Lopez: kill-switch -> safe, flips policy to previous behavior. rollback -> also OK but takes longer to converge for all pods. I'd flip the flag then start rollback.
Amelia Park: @deploy-bot can you flip feature-flag rlv2_ratecap_enabled = false in prod now? include command.
deploy-bot: running: curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/flags/rlv2_ratecap_enabled -d '{"env":"prod","value":false}' --auth token
deploy-bot: flag flip accepted (request id f-7721). propagating to edge and internal proxies.
Priya Singh: monitoring cache hits now. exemptions cache hit rate climbing back up.
Lia Gomez: auth tokens for acme-inc showing exemptions applied again. 429s dropping for them.
Amelia Park: support liaison Lia, can you confirm with SEV queue and customer pings? we need a list of impacted customers & ETA.
Lia Gomez: pinged support; acme reported 15% requests failed for their workflows, finco reported job retries. estimated incident start 16:42 UTC, impact window ~18m so far.
Mateo Lopez: deploy-bot, initiate rollback to commit abc123 (pre-change) across us-east-1 (canary->100%)
deploy-bot: rollback in progress, rolling update 3/10 pods -> 10/10 pods. tracking rev abc123.
Alex Wu: while rollback completes i'll prep a small patch to normalize cache keys and add an integration test for exemptions shapes.
Priya Singh: quick sanity: token-accounting ledger totals briefly drifted. requeued some accounting writes; no permanent loss observed. I'll add a verification job.
Amelia Park: metrics update — global 429 rate now down from 28% -> 4% in last 3m. latency stable.
Lia Gomez: support update: notified top 5 customers with mitigation details and ETA to full recovery. they want postmortem and SLA credit evaluation.
Mateo Lopez: rollback finished at 16:59 UTC 2320000740. all pods at abc123. canary checks green.
deploy-bot: rollout complete. health checks OK.
Alex Wu: confirmed exemptions cache key back to old behavior. new integration test added to PR#412.
Priya Singh: ledger parity check running, no accounting divergence found after replays. leaving monitoring for 1h.
Amelia Park: good job. quick post-incident plan: - add pre-rollout test for exemptions with representative tokens - gate canary on exempted-customer error-rate - add alert for cache-hit-drop during deploy - update runbook with kill-switch steps and who to page - support to prepare SLA credit template.
Mateo Lopez: i'll own the runbook update and the gating metric.
Alex Wu: i'll push the fix + tests and follow up in a PR.
Lia Gomez: i'll coordinate customer comms and collect precise impact numbers for billing.
Amelia Park: handing to SRE follow-up (non-urgent): please open postmortem ticket and link logs. Reassign to Mateo/Alex/Pria.
Priya Singh: opening postmortem ticket EM-2320 and linking graphs.
Amelia Park: incident resolved for oncall. closing channel in 30m unless new alerts. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: rate-limiter regression mitigated. Summary: feature-flag flip + rollback restored exemptions and lowered 429s.
